payload.description: A budget line for licensing on its own. Norwich's 2026-2027 General Fund budget is the most detailed money document the council publishes, and its service-by-service table stops at planning and regulatory services: licensing sits in there alongside planning, building control and the rest, budgeted together at £5.44m gross. So we can show the group's figures, never licensing's.
